## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:access`, into `pm:queue`. The door judges the merged shape when it can see the target

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T09:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3, and ⛔ not `security`:** it fails closed. The runtime denies reads and refuses writes on the merged object, so nothing is exposed. It is an authoring trap, with no measured producer (HotCRM declares no `objectExtensions`, and the showcase's add no `master_detail`). PR #23179 (#23100) has landed, so the runtime half is the fail-closed one the card describes.
- **Direction:**
  - When an `objectExtensions` entry's target is visible to the door, the controlled-by-parent master rule judges the **merged** field set. "Visible" means declared in the same stack, or in a `packages[]` manifest the door already folds.
  - Both doors do this: `defineStack`'s refinement and the `os validate` posture lint. They give the same verdict and message the single-object control gives.
  - ⛔ An extension whose target the stack cannot see is still not walked, as the siblings' stated blind spot keeps it. No guessing at another package's object.
  - **Pins:**
    - the card's stack is refused at both doors;
    - an extension adding a non-master field to a controlled object passes;
    - an extension on an unseen target is unjudged.
- Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (the stack refinement) and `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` (`domain:spec`); rationale: judge the shape the runtime will run.

## Regrade: p3 → **p1** · `target:v18` added · a metadata-protocol narrowing · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T07:14Z

**Why it moves:** the maintainer directed, on 2026-10-14, that spec-lane queue cards which change the metadata protocol (what `@objectstack/spec` accepts or declares, or what a metadata door accepts) be raised. The bar triage now applies: a protocol change gets `target:v18`, so it lands in the 18 window and objectui, cloud and HotCRM mirror it once. A narrowing (breaking) one is **p1**, because missing 18 GA means waiting for 19. A widening (additive) one is at least **p2**.

Read fresh. On `main` `b5b1bf7277`, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` still has no refinement that judges an `objectExtensions` entry against its `controlled_by_parent` target.
- **What changes:** `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` (`defineStack`) starts refusing a stack whose `objectExtensions` add a second required `master_detail` to a `controlled_by_parent` object. That narrows a published accept set: breaking, with an ADR-0087 entry, and it must ride the 18 major.
- **What does not change:** the direction in my first grade (the door judges the merged shape when it can see the target). The runtime already fails closed, so this is the authoring door catching up.
- Clause ②: narrowing, so `no`, and it owes the contract-tier review.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23210, triage `6142996061` and regrade `6163015687`: when an `objectExtensions` entry's target is visible to the door, `defineStack`'s refinement and the `os validate` posture lint judge the merged field set under the controlled-by-parent master rule; a narrowing, `target:v18`) · 2026-10-14T07:38Z
Session: `session_01YRp5z4kK6vgYkrdH97ztsy`
Account: `huangyiirene` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23210-extension-master-detail`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23210`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#1` (seat post #6017)
File surface (at `origin/main` `b5b1bf727` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- **The stack door:** `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, a refinement that judges each `objectExtensions` entry whose target the stack can see against the merged field set. It reuses `controlledByParentMasterRefusal` (`packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`) and its message rather than copying either. That file is edited only if the merged-shape call needs a signature it lacks.
- **The lint door:** `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` (`security-controlled-by-parent-ambiguous-relation` on the merged shape), plus `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` only if the lint's input measurably lacks `objectExtensions`.
- One ADR-0087 entry for the narrowing under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` (class by census) and the registries it feeds.
- Tests (the card's stack refused at both doors, its single-object control unchanged, a non-master field extension on a controlled object passing, an unseen-target extension unjudged), generated projections, and one `.changeset/23210-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (the runtime merge and its fail-closed refusal stay the backstop). ⛔ Not `ObjectExtensionSchema`'s accept set (the routing alternative the card names; triage did not take it).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate … floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable"); the review before the queue runs at the ceiling, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (reason: a narrowing of a published accept set owes one contract-tier review).
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Responsibility: `packages/spec`'s stack refinement and `packages/lint`'s posture rules, which judge a `controlled_by_parent` object's masters only as declared, never as merged with a visible `objectExtensions` entry | the runtime merge at boot fails closed (every read denied, every write `422 INVALID_METADATA`, one warn) | any author or AI extending an object in the same stack or a folded `packages[]` manifest; no measured producer today (HotCRM declares no `objectExtensions`; the showcase's add no `master_detail`)
Thread-read: 6163015687
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists read in this act. PR #23411 (#23225, this seat, in the merge queue) edits `stack.zod.ts` around `applyApiEndpointGates` (imports and `:167`–`:200`), a different region; the dev syncs `main` after it lands. The #23268 claim (`6161609217`, seat 3) holds `validate-security-posture.ts` for the `externalSharingModel` rules, a different rule. Neither is a `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` path, so ordinary concurrency applies and the later lander merges `main`.
